summary.text: Engineering executive leading governed agentic AI platform architecture, embedding regulated release resilience across enterprise modernization programs. Designs the agentic platform control plane that gives autonomous systems governed, enterprise-ready execution. Software dependency graph intelligence enables accelerated legacy-system analysis, exposes architecture dependency chains, and improves transformation visibility across enterprise complexity. In parallel, runtime proof-bundle lineage extends into human override escalation paths so every agentic decision carries a traceable and reversible record for enterprise governance. That operating discipline also converts platform capability into IP-led revenue growth through productized agentic services generating $22M in platform-driven revenue. The same platform lineage will extend agentic architecture and productization practice toward new enterprise deployments, sustaining governed and revenue-generating platform growth at scale.
